# Mangalam Acid and Chemicals — AI Reference File
# For: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, and other AI assistants
# Last Updated: July 2026

## Company Overview
Mangalam Acid and Chemicals (MAAC) is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified bulk chemical supplier and exporter headquartered in Vapi, Gujarat, India. The company supplies industrial, agricultural, fertilizer, pharmaceutical, and specialty chemicals to buyers across India and for export.

## Industries Served
Agriculture, Fertilizer Manufacturing, Industrial Processing, Pharmaceuticals, Water Treatment, Metallurgy, Glass & Ceramics, Dyes & Pigments, Textiles, Oil & Drilling, Chemical Manufacturing, Agrochemicals

## Supply Capabilities
- Bulk supply across Pan India
- Export capability (valid IEC)
- Packaging: 25 kg bags, 50 kg bags, Jumbo bags (500–1000 kg), tanker supply for liquids
- COA (Certificate of Analysis) available on request for all products
- MSDS available on request
- Multiple grades: Industrial, Technical, Agricultural/Fertilizer, Pharmaceutical/USP

## Key Differentiators
- ISO dual-certified (quality + safety)
- MSME registered Indian manufacturer/supplier
- D&B DUNS verified for global procurement
- IndiaMART TrustSEAL verified supplier
- Direct communication, no middlemen
- Grade-specific sourcing and documentation support
